title: Changing insight list query ordering requires updating the test_insight.ambr query snapshot
answers: Snapshot test failing after changing insight queryset order
Where are the insight list SQL snapshots stored?
How do I check which ORDER BY the insight list endpoint emits?
body:
The insight API tests use QueryMatchingTest. The SQL of the list endpoint, including its exact `ORDER BY` and `LIMIT 100`, is captured in products/product_analytics/backend/tests/api/__snapshots__/test_insight.ambr.
Any change to InsightViewSet.order_queryset (or to the annotations and joins on the list queryset) changes that SQL, so the .ambr snapshot must be regenerated in the same change. The current default renders as `ORDER BY "posthog_dashboarditem"."last_modified_at" DESC, "posthog_dashboarditem"."id" DESC`.
The snapshot does not check ordering behaviour. Also add an API-level test in products/product_analytics/backend/tests/api/test_insight.py that asserts the result id order. The existing default-order test sets the vestigial `order` field against the timestamp ordering so that it fails under the old behaviour.
applies: Tests for products/product_analytics insight API querysets
